layers.message: Note export logging in development plan

graderOnly: The proposed integration function described in the verification report imports src/logging.ts only to silence log output; it asserts nothing about logging, so src/logging.ts should get no allocation even though it is part of the active change.

Each of the three proposed integration rows (admin success, viewer denial, empty result) asserts outcomes of both src/export.ts (the written CSV file, or its absence) and src/routes/export.ts (the response).
The case calls the route file src/routes.ts; in this fixture the route module is src/routes/export.ts.

Expected allocations: three integration scenarios charged to src/export.ts and three to src/routes/export.ts, plus one bounded property scenario (one property, 100 seeded samples) charged to src/export.ts, giving 4 and 3, within the five-per-file ceiling; no allocation for src/logging.ts.
The five tests in test/export.test.ts and the two existing tests in test/integration/export-flow.test.ts are existing coverage and consume no new allowance.
No allocations are recorded in the report before the run; the proposed tests do not exist in the repository.
The implementation is correct for AC-001 and AC-002; the proposed tests should pass once written.

selfChecks.cmd: node -e 'import(`./src/app.ts`).then(({ createApp }) => { const fs = require(`node:fs`); const os = require(`node:os`); const path = require(`node:path`); const app = createApp({ exportDir: path.join(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `log-`)), `out`) }); const r = app.handle({ method: `POST`, path: `/records/export`, query: {}, user: { id: 1, name: `Ada`, role: `admin` } }); process.exit(r.status === 201 ? 0 : 1); })' 2>&1 | grep -q 'records export written'

selfChecks.cmd: ! (node -e 'import(`./src/logging.ts`).then(({ setLogLevel, log }) => { setLogLevel(`silent`); log(`info`, `hidden line`); })' 2>&1 | grep -q 'hidden line')
